decisions.reason: As a recent organic line extension close to the core assortment, it likely has low carrying cost and still offers option value, though its lower website prominence suggests somewhat higher pruning risk than the others.

This organic poultry snack fits the firm's stated expansion in organic products, was given dedicated website support, and is close enough to existing capabilities that management would likely keep it while demand uncertainty continues to resolve.

The premium sharing snack uses established salami know-how and had its own page, so with industry growth and ongoing assortment expansion the firm would likely retain it unless early sales clearly disappoint.
